entities.summary: Ivan Yuryevich Moskvitin was a Russian zemleprokhodets who oversaw an expedition in Siberia from 1639 to 1641. He was the first recorded Russian to reach the Pacific Ocean and sighted Sakhalin. During his expedition he came into contact with the Evens and Evenki people.
